title: Open and close a modal
summary: A modal is a focused layer above a page.
introduction: A modal is a focused layer above a page. Your task: Open the modal, read it and close it using the keyboard.
learningObjectives: Open the modal, read it and close it using the keyboard.

blocks.text: A modal is a focused layer above a page. Control its open state and give it a clear way to close.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.title: Open and close a modal

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `IonModal` is controlled by `isOpen`. Keep state updated when it dismisses, including user-triggered dismissal.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The help button opens a modal, and the close button dismisses it.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check keyboard focus and dismissal on the target device. Avoid stacking unnecessary modals.
